title.en: Buying a product with a coupon

intro.sr: Standardan tok kupovine: klijent bira proizvod, dodaje ga u korpu, primenjuje popust kuponom na naplati i potvrđuje porudžbinu.
intro.en: The standard purchase flow: a customer picks a product, adds it to the cart, applies a coupon discount at checkout, and confirms the order.

registracija.sr: Klijent se registruje popunjavanjem forme sa imenom, prezimenom, email adresom i lozinkom.
registracija.en: The customer registers by filling in a form with their name, email, and password.

prijava.sr: Nakon registracije, klijent se prijavljuje na svoj novi nalog.
prijava.en: After registering, the customer logs into their new account.

otvaranje-stranice-proizvoda.sr: Klijent otvara stranicu proizvoda i vidi opis, cenu i dostupne varijante.
otvaranje-stranice-proizvoda.en: The customer opens the product page and sees the description, price, and available variants.

dodavanje-u-korpu.sr: Klikom na „Dodaj u korpu” proizvod se dodaje u korpu klijenta.
dodavanje-u-korpu.en: Clicking "Add to cart" adds the product to the customer's cart.

otvaranje-korpe.sr: Klijent otvara korpu i vidi šta je do sada dodao pre nego što nastavi na naplatu.
otvaranje-korpe.en: The customer opens the cart and reviews what's been added before proceeding to checkout.

prelazak-na-naplatu.sr: Klijent prelazi na stranicu za naplatu, gde unosi podatke za dostavu.
prelazak-na-naplatu.en: The customer moves to the checkout page, where they enter delivery details.

unos-podataka-za-dostavu.sr: Klijent unosi telefon i adresu dostave, potrebne za obradu porudžbine.
unos-podataka-za-dostavu.en: The customer enters a phone number and delivery address, required to process the order.

primena-kupona.sr: Klijent unosi kod kupona i primenjuje popust - sistem odmah prikazuje umanjen iznos.
primena-kupona.en: The customer enters a coupon code and applies the discount - the system immediately shows the reduced amount.

potvrda-porudzbine.sr: Klijent potvrđuje porudžbinu. Za standardnu dostavu, cena se odmah izračunava - nema koraka čekanja procene kao kod velikih/teških artikala.
potvrda-porudzbine.en: The customer confirms the order. For standard shipping, the price is calculated immediately - there's no shipping-quote waiting step like there is for large/heavy items.

potvrda-preko-linka.sr: Klijent klikom na link iz email potvrde (ovde simulirano direktnim otvaranjem linka) finalizuje porudžbinu.
potvrda-preko-linka.en: The customer finalizes the order by clicking the link from the confirmation email (simulated here by opening the link directly).
